name: @campsite/api-dev
description: Turbo wrapper for the Rails API dev processes. The api/ directory is a standalone pnpm+bundler project (own lockfile, own mise toolchain) and is deliberately NOT a workspace member; this package only exposes its dev processes as turbo tasks. `mise x --` resolves api/mise.toml (Ruby 4.0.6, Node 26) regardless of the monorepo toolchain.

scripts.dev:web: cd ../../api && mise x -- bundle exec rails server -p 3001 -b 127.0.0.1
scripts.dev:worker: cd ../../api && mise x -- bundle exec sidekiq -C config/sidekiq.yml
